description: Ends the stored connection between this chat and the host's WordPress site and forgets that the site was ever connected, so a later chat does not offer it again. Take it only when the host clearly wants that, for example "Take my site out of this chat." It needs the session id. It cannot come back after a restart: the connection has to be approved again in the host's own browser before anything can run. The site itself stays untouched, and only this app is ended. With all set to true every app of the host is disconnected, and only after the host said so. Words hosts use: disconnect, remove my site, end connection, sign out

all.description: Only after the host said so: end every connection of this host, in all apps, not just this one.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_disconnect_wordpress
title: Disconnect the WordPress site
